properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Anthony's words, 2026-10-29: "the agent ... can focus on the "holes" in the proof. Then explore them, test them, and "write" them down. It can also iterate through trial and error and again, can write this down continue trying to solve something. ... For the "holes", these are almost like a use of the "/brainstorm" skill to reason what the solutions to the holes could be."

OPTIONS, none chosen:
(a) A SERVED SKILL for working a hole: read the hole back from the design; brainstorm candidate bridges (recorded as speculation, the accepted practice); test each (a counterexample search or numerical check in the calc helper, a known theorem that would imply it, a special case); record each failure as a failed route with the step it breaks at; stop at a stated budget.
(b) NOTHING NEW FIRST: run design-a-proof, brainstorm and the speculative-link practice as they are on one hole, and record what was missing.
(c) TWO AGENTS PER HOLE: one proposes, one tries to break it, each starting fresh from the design; the person rules.
(d) A FRESH AGENT PER ROUND, given only the design's read-back, never the previous transcript. This is the heart of Anthony's thesis made testable: if the design is enough, a fresh agent should pick up where the last one stopped.

PUSHBACK:
- A numerical test can refute a candidate but cannot prove one. The loop will produce many refutations and few proofs; the record has to make that honest, not hopeful.
- Without a stopping rule an agent loops: the same failed idea, reworded. Recording failed routes is what lets a later round see it was tried (idea D, a failed route as a record, is still open).
- Brainstorming candidates is where the agent's own mathematical ability still decides everything; the design narrows what it must hold, not how good the idea is.

COST (a finding): (b) cheapest; (d) small on top of (b), and it is what tests the thesis; (a) moderate, a skill; (c) about twice (b) per hole.
properties.name: OPEN — how does an agent work a hole in a proof: brainstorm what could close it, test each candidate, write down what failed and why, and go again, starting each round from the design rather than from its memory?
properties.rationale:
The working loop Anthony described, separated from the question of which problem to take on and from how the result is checked.
